'''Allya's Exile''' was a powerful [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] sometimes used in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] construction during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The crystal imparted an incredible burn affliction when used during combat, generating an outstanding amount of heat. The crystal was named after the Rogue Jedi, Allya.

The Allya's Exile crystal gave a lightsaber blade an amazing scarlet color which reflected the special color crystal's unbelievably hot qualities. It was similar to the [[Sigil (crystal)|Sigil crystal]] in usage. Nonetheless, Allya's Exile exceeded the properties of a Sigil crystal completely.

==Behind the scenes==
Allya's Exile appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Allya's Exile was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]]," introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]]" on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 19}}</ref>
